The '''Crossing Woods''' was a forested area located in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on [[Voss]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crossing Woods appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
